description: Independent AralField 2018 Haloxylon validation set used by Phase 6 (train_suitability_model.py) and Phase 7 (spatial_validation.py) to report the independent AralField AUC. 11 field points.
status: frozen external input (field columns) + script-regenerable RS columns. Previously the ndmi/msavi columns were sampled by a lost process (RISK-1, CODE_ENGINEERING_AUDIT R1); they are now regenerable byte-identically by scripts/v6/build_aralfield_validation.py --rasters.

field_survey.source: AralField 2018 Haloxylon field survey (independent of the lab/saxaul-label data)
field_survey.note: These columns are the FROZEN field observations (coordinates, Haloxylon presence, vegetation, note); they are not derivable from rasters and are the committed external input. ndmi/msavi are sampled from the 30m stack below.
